name: CritPt
description:
Probing the Critical Point (CritPt) of AI Reasoning: a Frontier Physics Research Benchmark
	

|🌐 Website | GitHub | 📖 Paper |

	
		
		Dataset description
	

CritPt (Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test; reads as "critical point") is the first benchmark designed to test LLMs on unpublished, research-level reasoning tasks that broadly covers modern physics research areas, including condensed matter, quantum physics, atomic, molecular & optical physics, astrophysics… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CritPt-Benchmark/CritPt.
evaluation_method: human_eval / expert grading (task success rate / solution correctness judged by domain experts)
typical_sota_score: low — often ≤30% task success on the hardest items (varies widely by model and subtask)
reputation: A niche, research-oriented benchmark designed to probe LLMs on unpublished, research-level physics problems; of interest to a small community of AI + physics researchers.
